claim: LangGraph uses checkpointed state as thread-scoped short-term memory and stores as cross-thread long-term memory.
Long-term agent memory can be semantic, episodic, or procedural.
LangMem supports hot-path tools and a background manager for extracting, consolidating, and updating knowledge.
Mem0 exposes add, search, update, delete, history and scoped memory APIs.
locator: Repository README and AGENTS.md core APIs

claim: MemGPT manages multiple memory tiers to extend effective context within a limited model context window.
Graphiti stores entities, temporally valid facts, provenance episodes and custom ontology types.
Cognee combines embeddings, graph reasoning and ontology generation for persistent cross-session memory.
Generative Agents stores experience records, synthesizes reflections, and dynamically retrieves memories for planning.
Reflexion stores verbal reflections from task feedback in an episodic memory buffer for later trials.
The benchmark suite covers factual recall, temporal reasoning, multi-hop inference and cross-session memory.
